description: Local CVE/ruleset used by the credentialed SSH compliance auditor. Package names are matched against installed dpkg/rpm packages; version comparison uses PEP 440-style loose numeric comparison.

rules.title: Outdated OpenSSL package
rules.description: Installed OpenSSL-related packages appear older than the local remediation baseline.
rules.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL / libssl packages to a vendor-supported release at or above the baseline.

rules.title: Outdated OpenSSH server package
rules.description: OpenSSH server package is below the local secure baseline and may be affected by known remote issues.
rules.remediation: Upgrade openssh-server to a patched vendor release and restart sshd after validation.

rules.title: Outdated sudo package
rules.description: sudo is below the local remediation baseline associated with privilege-escalation class issues.
rules.remediation: Upgrade sudo via the distribution package manager and verify sudoers policy least privilege.

rules.title: Outdated curl / libcurl package
rules.description: curl/libcurl packages are older than the local baseline covering heap overflow class defects in SOCKS5 handling.
rules.remediation: Upgrade curl and libcurl packages to a patched release.

rules.title: Linux kernel package below baseline
rules.description: Installed kernel packages appear below the configured local baseline. Confirm with vendor advisories for the exact distribution kernel.
rules.remediation: Apply distribution kernel security updates and reboot into the patched kernel.

rules.title: Outdated Python 3 runtime package
rules.description: Python 3 packages are below the local remediation baseline.
rules.remediation: Upgrade Python packages through the OS vendor repositories or managed runtimes.
